item.tib: dbal phur gsang ba gting rdzogs kyi pho nya las mkhan brgya rtsa'i bskul pa
item.coloph: dbal phur las mkhan bskul pa dam nyams srog gi spu gri zhes bya ba/ dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyi bka' rgyud / pas dbal bon bco brgyad gyer spungs bcas la brgyud cing / dus kyi bstan pa 'phel 'grib skabs/ khod spungs dran pa'i thugs la sbas/ phyis dus bstan pa'i dbu brnyes tshe/ las ldan sngags 'chang dbal 'bar stag slag can la snyan du brgyud pa'o//
